author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I use AI to write a rebuttal of this anti-AI philosophy paper. I submitted my paper to philpapers, I am not sure they will accept it or not, they may think it is just some AI slop from a nobody.
With help of AI, philosophy euthenists can write academic philosophy paper on the same level as the philosophy professors. All you need is just good thinking, you don't need good writing anymore.
Fear and Loathing in Silicon Valley: Does AI Threaten our Valuing Practices
Jordan MacKenzie
https://lnkd.in/gyT4mCf9
